title: Build a Wind-Down Routine
body_markdown:
# Build a Wind-Down Routine

A consistent 30-minute pre-sleep ritual signals your body that it is time to rest. Dim the lights, put devices away, and try a calming activity like reading.

title: Caffeine Cutoff Times
body_markdown:
# Caffeine Cutoff Times

Caffeine has a half-life of 5-7 hours. Stop intake by 2pm to give it time to clear before bedtime.

title: Recovering from Sleep Debt
body_markdown:
# Recovering from Sleep Debt

A guide to staged recovery from chronic short sleep, with weekly catch-up plans.
